result: I would change the world by ensuring that every person has access to clean, safe, and affordable drinking water. This is a fundamental human right that is still not guaranteed for many people around the world. According to the United Nations, around 2.2 billion people lack access to safely managed drinking water, and about 4.2 billion people lack access to safely managed sanitation services. By providing universal access to clean water, we can significantly improve health outcomes, boost economic development, and enhance overall quality of life for billions of people. This would also help to reduce the gender inequality that exists due to women and girls often being responsible for collecting water, which can take hours each day and limit their access to education and other opportunities.
